name: dialog
title: Dialog (Base UI)
description: Animated modal dialog with spring-based scale and opacity transitions in three widths (sm, lg, and an xl canvas for composed layouts such as a sidebar), plus a container prop to scope it to a region. Base UI flavor.
docs: Docs & live playground: https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/docs/dialog. Craft notes, the color, layout and motion decisions to keep when you change it: https://github.com/mickadesign/fluid-functionalism/blob/main/skills/fluid-functionalism/references/craft.md#dialog.
